description: Generate an End-User License Agreement (EULA) for a software application using privacypage.io. Returns a free 25-line preview and a documentId; the full document is unlocked with a one-time license ($9.99, no subscription).

companyName.description: Company or developer name, e.g. 'Acme Inc.'

restrictions.description: Usage restrictions to include. Common values: 'No reverse engineering', 'No redistribution', 'No modifications', 'No commercial use (free apps)', 'No resale', 'Single user license'.

name: generate_eula
title: Generate EULA
